text:
ana: Heads-up — opened PR to tweak HPA and add VPA baseline for frontend; also minor Karpenter provisioner changes and secret wiring for node bootstrap. Need a quick pass and a secrets check.

mike: PR?

ana: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/421

sophia: skimmed — HPA target from 70% -> 60% looks fine but what's the justification? heavier realtime loads?

ana: yes, we've seen consistent CPU spikes at 65-68% and bursts that push response latency. lowering target reduces ramp-up lag. also adding a VPA recommendation mode to capture memory drift.

raj: are we going to run both Karpenter and Cluster Autoscaler in this cluster? last time they clashed.

ana: cluster uses karpenter for node lifecycle. CA is disabled in this env, I removed helm release in the changes. check the provisioner label changes in the TF.

mike: can you paste the TF snippet that wires the bootstrap secret (kms-decrypt key) into the karpenter node user-data? want to confirm no plaintext.

ana: sure:
```
resource "aws_ssm_parameter" "karpenter_bootstrap_secret" {
  name  = "/redwood/prod/karpenter/bootstrap"
  type  = "SecureString"
  value = aws_kms_ciphertext.bootstrap_ciphertext.ciphertext_blob
}

resource "kubernetes_secret" "karpenter_bootstrap" {
  metadata {
    name = "karpenter-bootstrap"
    namespace = "kube-system"
  }
  data = {
    config = base64encode(aws_ssm_parameter.karpenter_bootstrap_secret.value)
  }
}
```

sophia: we shouldn't base64encode the already encrypted payload — that will double-wrap. Instead SSM SecureString should be decrypted on retrieval by the node's KMS role or via SSM GetParameter with WithDecryption=true. The TF above stores the encrypted blob in k8s secret which means nodes can't decrypt without KMS access.

raj: agreed — better approach is to store only a reference and use instance profile to fetch/decrypt at bootstrap. also ensure the node role has kms:Decrypt for the key alias.

ana: updated PR to remove base64encode and switch to storing a reference tag. Also added IAM policy change in the TF. Can someone review the IAM snippet?

mike: quick look — the IAM statement allows kms:Decrypt but also kms:ReEncrypt* which we should avoid. please drop re-encrypt.

ana: done, pushed. infra-bot: terraform plan for branch autoscaler/audit returned 0 changes for prod but 3 for staging (provisioner label rename + iam policy tweak + remove ca helm). plan output: https://ci.redwood/plan/7890

infra-bot: comment: ensure you run `kubectl apply -f crds/karpenter.yaml` before provisioning nodes — CRDs changed in v0.28

sophia: can we add a canary rollout? maybe deploy the env var that enables vpa in staging first.

ana: good idea — I'll add a canary via kustomize overlay and tag the PR. assigning to @mike and @raj for quick review :thumbsup:

mike: will review today.

raj: quick note — add an annotation to the provisioner to exclude system-node pool to avoid scheduling control-plane pods on new nodes.

ana: ack. thanks everyone :rocket:
